title: Chapter 1040
text: “ORNATE LANGUAGE … DRAMATIC EMOTIONS.” — People In the grand manner of Interview with the Vampire, Anne Rice’s new novel moves across time and the continents, from nineteenth-century Vienna to a St. Charles Greek Revival mansion in present-day New Orleans to dazzling capitals of the modern-day world, telling a story of two charismatic figures hound to each other by a passionate commitment to music as a means of rapture, seduction, and liberation. “FIENDISH DELIGHTS.” — Playboy
